headlines: SPY V-shaped reversal: opened 713.56, low ~707.85, now 715.72 (-0.02% vs 715.87 close), day high 718.28 (Stocktwits 15:06Z)
Stocklake 14:09Z snapshot (pre-reversal): VIX 30.4, Fear & Greed 14.6 extreme fear, breadth 11.7% oversold vs 2.7% overbought; SPY RSI 31.6, QQQ -1.57%, IWM -2.18%, GLD -2.5%, TLT +0.8%
Micron -5.9% at 650 (trending #3); Anthropic (ANT) -7.4% at 90 but bounced off ~84.7 low; IREN -7.3%; PayPal -2.4%
Intuit pared loss to -3.9% at 298 after opening ~284 on weak guidance and Mailchimp sale
Stocktwits SPY message volume HIGH (63); a post cites RSP (equal-weight) strength this morning
Econ calendar: no US releases today; UK retail sales beat prior (+0.7% m/m); Nov 20 is monthly options expiration

rumors.why: A real bank liquidity scare would hit financials and SPY hard; no evidence offered

rumors.text: Intuit will take another multibillion write-off on Credit Karma, like Mailchimp (carried over)
rumors.why: An impairment would confirm Credit Karma weakness; stock already recovering intraday

rumors.text: Hunterbrook short report alleges AMD export-control issues; AMD disputes (carried over, no new detail)
rumors.why: A probe on a megacap AI chip name keeps pressure on semis and QQQ

rumors.text: The bounce is a bull trap; one last dump coming
rumors.why: If right, SPY retests the ~708 low into the opex close

rumors.text: Washout is over; SPY reclaims 720 on equal-weight strength
rumors.why: Short covering from extreme fear and oversold breadth could carry SPY green

plays.reason: Sharp intraday reversal from ~708 to ~716 with extreme fear (F&G ~15), RSI ~31 and bearish-leaning crowd (53% bears) = room for short covering
plays.catalyst: Opex-day dealer flows; risk is a fade/retest as crowd calls bull trap and QQQ/IWM lag

readings.whats_new: SPY flipped from ~708 premarket/early low to 715.72, essentially flat on the day, reversing the morning's -0.6% gap; Intuit and Anthropic pared losses while Micron (-5.9%) is the new laggard. Stocklake's 14:09Z snapshot showed fear deepening (VIX 30.4, Fear & Greed 14.6) before the bounce, so those readings may now overstate fear. Stocktwits SPY sentiment edged to 53 with bears at 53%, so the crowd has not chased the reversal.
